version.author: NVSD
version.changelog:
Major update: horizontal scrollbar, grid/quantize system, warp mode improvements, and many stability fixes.
Features: - Horizontal scrollbar below waveform with zoom buttons and drag handle - Grid system with beat/bar ruler, quantize panel, and snapping - Rebindable Shift+Scroll horizontal pan shortcut - Tooltips toggle and tab tooltips - Shaped waveform toggle in envelope bar - Autozoom button magnifying glass icon
Fixes: - Alt+Tab no longer leaves modifier keys stuck or destabilizes view - Envelope lock works correctly for crop, alt-drag, and double-click in warp mode - Envelope segments take priority over markers when overlapping - CF_Preview playback matches take playrate (varispeed) with correct playhead tracking - Preview cursor position correct in warp mode with non-1.0 playrate - Undo point created when focus lost during active marker drag - Settings page no longer scrolls during shortcut capture - Warp mode transitions no longer cause view jumps or pixelated waveforms - Extreme zoom performance and sample-level zoom range - Toolbar and toggle button persistence across restarts - Pitch knob double-click reset, marker selection in warped view

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog:
Double-click dispatcher, MIDI handling, warp multi-select, and fixes.
Features: - Double-click dispatcher: audio items open ItemView, MIDI items open MIDI editor - Graceful MIDI item handling with disabled UI shell instead of blank window - Warp marker multi-select, click-to-deselect, and selective quantize - Always-visible edit cursor line on waveform - Double-click setup instructions added to Help tips
Fixes: - Pitch semitones/cents display truncates toward zero (sign matches pitch direction) - Remove edge auto-scroll, add pitch gutter reset - Fix settings icon picker column layout - Fix warp-mode preview cursor and waveform rendering

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog:
Playhead restyle, MIDI item polish, tab hover fix, DoubleClick auto-registers.
- Playhead: muted teal 1px line matching REAPER edit cursor, distinct from markers - MIDI items: disabled controls no longer highlight on hover (mute/toolbar/settings still work) - Tab hover: subtle brightness instead of accent color so icons stay visible - Dock tip: corrected to "drag title bar into docker" - DoubleClick action now auto-registers in Action List via ReaPack

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog:
Sausage file navigation, Grab from REAPER, 3-button FX toolbar, UI polish.
Features: - Sausage file navigation: Left/Right arrows skip between sound regions in multi-variation files - Grace period for rapid backward skipping (1.5s window) - Optional snap-click-to-sound preference (auto-snap clicks out of silence gaps) - During preview, arrow navigation instantly jumps playback to new region - Grab from REAPER button [G] imports shortcut bindings from REAPER's action list - 3-button FX toolbar: dedicated [+] Add, [bypass] toggle, and [FX] chain buttons - Unzoom All shortcut (Alt+Z) resets zoom to full source view
Fixes: - Gain slider taller with reduced top padding - Gain/Pitch/Pan labels moved up to reduce cramping - Region navigation correctly uses source-relative coordinates - Peak noise blips (1-2 column artifacts) skipped during navigation - Float round-trip precision fix for column conversion

version.author: NVSD
version.changelog:
Fix pitch dropdown clipping in docked windows.
- All three pitch dropdowns (algo, mode, flags) now cap to available window height with scrollbar - When space below is too tight (<5 rows), menu repositions to the right of the button - Side-placed menus use full window height, extending upward to show all items without scrolling - Menu width auto-expands to fit the widest item text - Shared scroll menu helpers eliminate duplicated scroll/scrollbar code
